newsitem.title: INDIA: India Rhone Poulenc Agro's CPs rated PR1 - CARE.
newsitem.headline: India Rhone Poulenc Agro's CPs rated PR1 - CARE.

text.p: Rhone Poulenc Agrochemicals (I) Ltd's 50 million rupees commercial paper (CP) borrowing scheme has been rated PR1, Credit Analysis & Research Ltd (CARE) said on Tuesday.
"Instruments with this rating would have superior capacity for repayment of short-term promissory obligations," CARE said in a statement.
The firm is 50.49 percent owned by Rhone-Poulenc Agrochimie S.A. of France, which is part of Rhone-Poulenc S.A. group. The rest is held by Rhone-Poulenc (India) Ltd.
It manufactures pesticide formulations which are bio-degradable and environmentally safe, CARE said.
The firm had sales of 720 million rupees for calendar 1996 and post-tax profit of 18 million rupees, it said.
